notes.title: TAKIBI Update1.3
notes.content:
The following functions have been added
Addition of a menu screen
　The menu screen is now displayed when the Esc key is pressed.

Volume control function added
　The volume can now be adjusted from the menu screen.
　It is possible to adjust the volume balance of all 9 types of sounds in the game.

Changed the sound when the item limit is reached.
　After the maximum number of items that can be added to a bonfire has been reached, the sound is no 　
　longer played when more items are added.
　sound is no longer played when adding more items after the limit of items that can be added to a 
　bonfire has been reached.


The following fixes have been made.
　Fixed a bug that temporarily prevented the selection of items.
　Fixed a bug that prevented the user from temporarily selecting an item that has been collected because 
　a branch or other object fell on top of the collected item and the user could not collect it at night.
　Fixed a bug that prevented the user from selecting temporarily collected items.

Fixed a bug in the game description paper.
　A typo in the game description has been fixed.
　Added explanation that only leaves can be collected by long-pressing them.
　Added explanation that the Esc key opens the menu screen.
　At the beginning of the game, the screen was dark and the paper was not visible.
　This problem has been solved by adding a light.

Fixed a bug that caused flames to last forever
　Fixed a bug that caused flames to last forever when burning barrels.
　Also, a bug that caused the flame to weaken when burning a wheel has been fixed.

notes.title: TAKIBI update1.2
notes.content:
The following elements were added
Addition of "Night Mode
　Added a mode where materials are infinite and night lasts forever. There is a game over, but the difficulty is low.

The following modifications were made.
Changed the UI of the start screen.
　Moved "Quit" button to the lower left corner.
　Added a new button for night mode.

notes.title: TAKIBI update 1.1
notes.content:
TAKIBI has been updated as follows!
Fallen leaves can now be collected by clicking and holding.
The morning is shortened and the night is lengthened.
The number of items that can be collected has been generally increased so that there is more room for more items.
Fixed a bug that prevented points from being obtained.
